You are a Senior Java Architect refactoring an existing Spring Boot in-memory cache implementation.

Current cache architecture:

* ConcurrentHashMap<K, CacheEntry<V>> as primary storage
* DelayQueue-based TTL eviction already implemented
* Fresh TTL and stale TTL support
* Cache metrics (hits, misses, staleHits, evictions)
* Max cache size enforcement
* Current LRU eviction scans entire cache:

```java
store.entrySet().stream()
    .min(...)
```

This is O(n) and becomes expensive as cache size
